digest.component_or_area: tickets-store repository and reconciler bridge-state cache
propositions: The reconciler's committed `.bridge_state` cache occupies 92% (approximately 1 GiB) of the tickets branch due to frequent writes of bookkeeping fields that are not read by application code.

Scattered edits to the sorted 18 MB `bindings.json` file defeat git delta compression, resulting in a measured marginal cost of 12.79 KB per version; deleting the `baseline_advanced_at` timestamp and moving rotation bookkeeping reduces this to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement) and halves version churn.

The approach keeps `.bridge_state` committed on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners requiring durable git-resident state, and addresses content/churn via selective field deletion and relocation rather than off-branch re-homing.

A one-time history rewrite using `git fast-export/filter/fast-import` reduces the tickets branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4% size) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with the rewritten HEAD tree byte-identical to the pre-rewrite tip after dynamic re-add.
